name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD): 10-Task 3D Biomedical Segmentation Benchmark
description: The Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) is a landmark 10-task biomedical image segmentation challenge covering multiple organs, imaging modalities (CT and MRI), and pathological conditions. Organized by King's College London, Memorial Sloan Kettering, and DKFZ, it encompasses 2,633 volumetric 3D scans across brain tumor, heart, liver, hippocampus, prostate, lung, pancreas, hepatic vessel, spleen, and colon segmentation.
